messages:
Priya (ACME): Hey team — after yesterday's SSO consent UI update our users get 403 when calling /v1/embeddings even though generation endpoints work. Error: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"embeddings"}
Alyssa (support): Thanks Priya — can you paste the introspect response or a redacted token so we can triage?
Priya (ACME): Introspect shows: scope: 'inference,generations;embeddings' — the consent UI started inserting semicolons between scopes for long lists.
Sam (backend): Interesting. Our auth proxy normalizes commas -> spaces but we don't handle semicolons. If the scope parser sees a semicolon it can drop the trailing item. Can you reproduce with curl? Example we used:
```
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.example.com/introspect -d 'token=REDACTED' 
# -> {"active":true, "scope":"inference,generations;embeddings"}
```
Sam (backend): Repro in local: auth-proxy log shows `scope_claims: "inference generations"` (embeddings omitted).
Marco (sre): Do we see fallback behavior? Any latency/regressions?
Priya (ACME): Yes — requests hit the fallback small-embed model and we saw higher latency and increased error rates for their consumer job. Logs attached: auth-proxy lines showing parsed scopes and a later authorization failure.
Alyssa (support): Impact looks like ~3% of their embedding calls fail with 403 and some silently routed to fallback. We should treat this as high priority for that tenant.
Sam (backend): Mitigation: I'll add semicolon->space normalization in auth-proxy and a small tolerant parser that accepts [' ', ',', ';'] as separators. Opening PR now.
Marco (sre): Will canary the change in us-west-2 and monitor the per-tenant 403 rate. Set alert if >0.5% above baseline.
eng-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy@fix/semicolon-normalize -> canary us-west-2 (deploy id d-8492)
Priya (ACME): Verified on their staging token — embeddings call returns 200 with vectors. Can we re-parse tokens issued in the last 24h for that tenant to avoid forcing re-login?
Alyssa (support): Creating backfill job to re-evaluate scope claims for active tokens for tenant acme-corp. Ticket CS-98321. We'll notify once done.
Sam (backend): PR merged. Added unit test for semicolons and an instrumentation trace that includes raw scope claim (redacted) to help future triage.
Marco (sre): Canary metrics look good, rolling to prod now. No spike in errors.
Priya (ACME): Customer confirmed production traffic now succeeds. Thanks for the fast turnaround.
Alyssa (support): Closing this thread once backfill completes and CS-98321 is updated. Thanks everyone :)
